ownerStatement: I approve USB Audio 0.4.2-experimental: it fixes the #2263 buzz on macOS and costs less CPU than 0.4.1; tested on my MKII on 26-27 November 2026.
reason: #2263: on macOS, 0.4.1's adaptive input and asynchronous recording slid the Mac's I/O buffer 2.6 frames a second until it buzzed; 0.4.2 sends the recording on the host's clock while the host plays in and trims the drift on the unit. Main + Cue now does the built-in's work (once-a-frame flag, the built-in's copy) and the POST gain history runs only for POST. Owner's MKII, macOS: 10 minutes clean; a Main + Cue recording's own cost about half of 0.4.1's (16 to 7.6 points of the frame interrupt in one scene), then 1.2 points and 9 of the longest frame less with the built-in's copy (A/B in one scene); every USB AUDIO setting changed idle, recording and playing in on 0.8.2 with no USB incident; the release on the flashed 0.8.2 installed, recorded and rolled back. Windows after the release, on the owner's PC (owner, 27 November 2026). Not run: 20 channels, an MKI, a Keep and a power cycle.
